notices.title: Riverton Digital Safety Workshops
notices.description: Fictional sample. Open solicitation for a nonprofit to run community cybersecurity workshops and hire trainers. Award ceiling: $180,000. No cash match required. Indirect costs allowed. Operating expenses and personnel costs allowed. 501(c)(3) may apply as lead.
notices.summary: Sample score. A workforce training grant a community nonprofit could lead and staff.
concerns: Confirm trainer qualifications in the official notice
